label: Search Vector Index
type: a vector index provided by the Search Service rather than the Index Service, supporting a single vector column
note: Filed here rather than under search: because the relation that introduces it already says which axis it belongs to: 'The Search Service provides [Search Vector Indexes] that support a single vector column' is service:search-service -providesIndexType-> this, and the same record asserts belongsToIndexClass index-class:vector. A round-11 agent wrote both relations correctly and kept the vector-index: prefix, so the predicate named the axis while the namespace contradicted it. Distinguish from index-type:hyperscale-vector and index-type:composite-vector, which are Index Service GSIs: the source separates them by capability, not just by provider - a Search Vector Index supports neither Euclidean distance nor an explicitly chosen quantization method, and falls back to a flat index below 1000 vectors. Distinguish also from search:full-text-index, the Search Service's non-vector index, and from fts:full-text-search, the capability.
relates_to_competency_question: What kinds of index can I create?
